degree_rationale: Treats the First Father in his five members of light (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) and twelve members — his interior structure as Father. Essence-anatomy of the inmost.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of the Father's own constitution — his light, fragrance, voice, and members. Reception within the celestial of his attributes.
grand_man_function: Celestial inner constitution of the Father — the receiving-into-understanding of his members.
title: The First Father and his attributes
